content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About IIML
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is located at Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. This position is at its Lucknow Campus, in the Operations & Supply Chain Management Area.

rows.pay: Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- a month (consolidated fellowship), plus HRA as per applicable norms

content_sections.heading: IIML Research Associate and Senior Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A completed Ph.D. with specialization in operations & supply chain management, industrial management, industrial engineering or related domains with quantitative rigor, demonstrating strong research competence and subject expertise. An excellent academic record with First division in PG from a reputed institute or university, completed in regular mode. At least one research paper published in ABDC A / ABS 3 / Clarivate Q1 and above listings in a peer-reviewed international journal, reflecting the ability to conduct independent research, apply appropriate methodologies and contribute to scholarly knowledge. PG preferably in M.Tech. / MBA, and B.Tech. at UG level. Demonstrated research experience in publishing high-quality research papers in reputed journals. Command over Python, including experience in analytics, simulation, optimization, statistical modeling, data analysis and reproducible research workflows. Prior experience of working in research or consultancy projects. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each position.

rows.requirement: Ph.D. with a minimum of 3 years of research experience
Ph.D. with a minimum of 2 years of research experience

content_sections.heading: Job Role
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will assist Prof. Yash Daultani in research-related activities. These include data analysis, literature review, empirical work, preparation of research output and any other academic work assigned.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized. Shortlisted candidates are contacted via email for an online interview, which is the first stage. The final selection stage can be offline or online.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely contractual in nature. The initial appointment is for 11 months and may be extended based on performance and institute requirements. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Canvassing through any means will be taken seriously, and the candidate is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIML Research Associate and Senior Research Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Choose the position you are applying for: Senior Research Associate, Research Associate 'A' or Research Associate 'B'. Clearly indicate that position in your application. Send your application and CV to [email protected] . Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation. Only selected candidates will be intimated, and no other query will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply if my Ph.D. is still in progress?
faq.answer: No. The notice requires a completed Ph.D. for all the positions.

faq.question: Q2. Which journal listings count for the publication requirement?
faq.answer: You need at least one paper in a peer-reviewed international journal listed in ABDC A, ABS 3, or Clarivate Q1 and above.

faq.question: Q3. Is Python mandatory?
faq.answer: No. Command over Python is listed as a desirable qualification, along with prior work on research or consultancy projects.

faq.question: Q4. What separates Research Associate 'A' from Research Associate 'B'?
faq.answer: Research Associate 'A' requires a Ph.D. with at least 2 years of research experience, while Research Associate 'B' requires a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. Will the interview be held in person?
faq.answer: The first-stage interview is online. The final selection stage can be either offline or online.

faq.question: Q6. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are contacted, and that contact is made via email.

faq.question: Q7. Can the 11-month contract be extended?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be extended further based on performance and institute requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Can I send my application by post?
faq.answer: No. The notice accepts applications only at the email address given and says no other mode will be accepted.
